nodes.label: The fully on-device iOS port is proposed but implementation-ready: design decisions are closed, no code work has started, and the target is an offline iPhone build containing UI, simulation, persistence, and local inference.

The locked iOS architecture introduces a dynamic InferenceBackend abstraction and a statically linked LiteRT-LM C ABI backend using Gemma 4 E2B by default, with token streaming and E4B as a device-gated quality option.

Models are delivered through Apple On-Demand Resources, saves resolve under Application Support, mod assets ship as Tauri resources, and safe-area, touch, map zoom, and keyboard occlusion are explicit UI contracts.

A Mac with Xcode, a physical iPhone 15 Pro or newer, a paid Apple developer account, ODR-packaged models, and measured prompt tuning are prerequisites; headless work can land scaffolding but cannot prove a runnable or shippable iOS backend.
